discovery.none: No automatic discovery protocol is documented for the direct PicoStill telemetry endpoint; obtain the appliance address from the router or trusted replacement-server registration.

identification.notes: No mDNS/SSDP identity or model-specific discovery response is published. Select the still by its known LAN address and confirm a well-formed /data response; do not infer support from another PicoBrew model's routes.

device.name: PicoBrew PicoStill (direct read-only telemetry)
device.notes:
SCOPE: only the PicoStill's direct, read-only GET /data telemetry route is declared as an appliance-local request. It returns nine comma-separated fields inside #...#. All fields remain raw strings: units, scaling, and conversion rules are not established. No temperature or pressure unit is assigned and no unit-bearing entity is declared.
Community replacement servers also implement PicoStill and other PicoBrew routes. Those routes run on the trusted replacement server and the appliance calls them; they are NOT endpoints on the PicoStill and are not appliance-local control. protocol_details.replacement_server_routes records this direction without making the routes executable.

openness.notes: The direct endpoint is reconstructed from a community replacement server's polling client, not from a published PicoBrew API document.

pairing.notes: The replacement server's poller issues unauthenticated plain-HTTP GET /data with no pairing or token. Reachability on the LAN is the only gate shown by that client. Keep the appliance and monitoring client on a trusted network. Other server-side routes may have different behavior.

unpair.notes: There is no direct client bond to revoke.

safety_advisory.detail: Read-only monitoring cannot establish that heating or pumping has ceased or that a fault is safe. Keep physical isolation and the appliance's own safety mechanisms available. Do not rely on picoChangeState, a closed session log, or any replacement-server response for emergency shutdown.
safety_advisory.summary: Distillation involves heat and pressure; telemetry and HTTP responses are not an emergency stop.

credentials.notes: The community direct poller sends no HTTP credential. Initial Wi-Fi provisioning and original server authorization are not established. A UID or registration token used by other PicoBrew routes is an identifier, not evidence of cryptographic authentication.
stored_on_device: Appliance network and service configuration, if present; exact provisioning is outside this spec

factory_reset.description: Do not factory-reset an appliance to obtain telemetry or to end a distillation session. Physical safety and power isolation are separate.
factory_reset.effect: Not established for the direct telemetry surface. No reset procedure or erase scope is inferred from server-side session cleanup, firmware replacement, or a closed log.

methods.description: Obtain the PicoStill's LAN address and issue read-only GET /data on port 80. If using a trusted replacement server for other features, keep its registration and DNS configuration on that server role and do not redirect direct telemetry requests to it.
methods.name: Read an already networked still

steps.action: Find the PicoStill's assigned address at the router or trusted replacement-server registration.
steps.expect: The still's LAN address is known without scanning or actuating it.

steps.action: Issue GET http://<still-address>/data and parse exactly one #...# record.
steps.expect: Nine raw string fields in the documented order; no state-changing request is sent.

setup.notes: A networked PicoStill can be read directly by address; no client onboarding is implemented by the community poller. Initial Wi-Fi join and appliance-to-vendor/replacement-server binding are separate and are not reconstructed here. A replacement server is not required merely to issue GET /data.

rejoin.notes: The appliance's Wi-Fi rejoin procedure is not established by the reviewed source. Changing a replacement server's DNS or registration does not prove an in-place Wi-Fi rejoin. No factory reset is advised.

testing.notes: Derived from chiefwigms/picobrew_pico 36acae3003845b72568ef5f7d6cf168acb6f9b69, principally its direct still poller and PicoStill routes. No appliance, heater, pump, distillation session, replacement server, or firmware endpoint was contacted. The parser is reported, not hardware-verified.

artifacts.description: Direct telemetry poller, replacement-server route direction, and no-op picoChangeState evidence.

evidence.documentation_review: Read the maintained replacement server's direct still poller and model routes at commit 36acae3003845b72568ef5f7d6cf168acb6f9b69, plus the existing PicoBrew research notes. The poller issues GET /data, strips the response, removes the outer characters, and unpacks nine comma-separated values. Its mapping labels t1-t4/pres but supplies no defensible units for this spec. The Pico S/C/Pro picoChangeState handler was checked separately and is a no-op beyond a blank response.
evidence.open_questions: Source-based parsing is not an appliance capture. Unit semantics, firmware coverage, fault behavior, and every state-changing operation remain open.

local_access.summary: The direct /data endpoint offers read-only telemetry on the appliance's LAN address without vendor cloud access. A trusted replacement server can separately provide recipe/session/firmware services to an appliance, but those are appliance-to-server roles and are not direct local control.

PicoStillData.description: One direct /data record. Numeric-looking values stay strings because units, scale, precision, and valid ranges are unknown. No entity or conversion consumes this format.

parse_rules: Strip surrounding HTTP whitespace only. Require both the leading and trailing # delimiters, then remove exactly those two characters.
Split the interior on every comma and require exactly nine fields. Do not silently accept missing or additional fields.
Preserve every field as a string, including leading zeros, empty errmsg, ok, and numeric-looking values. Perform no numeric conversion, unit conversion, rounding, or safety inference.
A comma inside errmsg has no documented escaping and makes the record invalid under the nine-field parser. Do not join fields to rescue it.

direct_appliance_telemetry.record_encoding: Parse the response as text independently of the HTTP Content-Type header; the actual MIME type is unestablished.

excluded_control_surfaces.reason: Avoid unsafe heating, pumping, distillation, and firmware operations and do not misplace replacement-server routes on the appliance.

no_emergency_stop.picoChangeState: The reviewed Pico S/C/Pro replacement handler only returns CRLF and performs no action; state labels do not change that finding.
no_emergency_stop.requirement: No HTTP route in this spec is an emergency-abort mechanism. Use physical power/isolation and the appliance's own safety controls for a fault.
no_emergency_stop.session_closure: Ending a Pico/Zymatic session or closing ZSession finalizes a server-side log, not proof that heater or pump activity stopped.

replacement_server_routes.trust_boundary: Scope any picobrew.com/www.picobrew.com DNS override to the appliance and trusted LAN. Do not expose the replacement server's unauthenticated admin/restart/shutdown routes. UIDs, registration tokens, and recipe IDs are identifiers, not proof of secure authentication.

remaining_unknowns: Units, scaling, precision, valid ranges, sentinel values, and conversion rules for t1-t4 and pres; no Celsius, Fahrenheit, or pressure unit is established.
Meaning and vocabulary of ok and errmsg, and assignments of d1/d2.
Whether any firmware escapes commas in errmsg; the recovered nine-way parser does not support them.
Supported PicoStill firmware versions and response/content-type variations on real appliances.
Initial Wi-Fi provisioning, rejoin, factory reset, original service authorization, and automatic discovery.
Actual heater/pump stop and fault behavior; replacement-server host tests and blank/no-op responses establish none.
